about.title: About AgriTech
about.subtitle: Building a transparent, resilient, and technologically empowered agricultural economy
about.missionText: AgriTech was conceived to eliminate intermediaries in agricultural commerce, deliver scientific precision farming to marginal smallholder farmers, and establish transparent wholesale commodity price discovery.
about.visionText: To pioneer an inclusive digital ecosystem where farmers earn fair rewards for their toil, food buyers secure unadulterated fresh produce, and agronomists empower millions through intelligent advisory systems.
